about: KUE Release 1 requirements, parsed from the requirements document. FR = functional, NFR = non-functional, CHK = a check that runs in code. A test that proves a requirement carries its id in the test name.

features.name: Approval by Touch ID or password

requirements.text: The ledger shall store work orders, steps, evidence, warrants, items, promises and answers as append-only records, each chained to the one before
An integrity check shall fail when any past record has been altered
Every write shall pass the privacy firewall, and a record of an unknown kind shall be refused
A typed request shall become a work order with a plain-language restatement, acceptance criteria and a due date, and you shall be able to correct the restatement before accepting it
A step shall be in exactly one state: Planned, Built, Verified, Signed, Blocked or Failed. An illegal change of state shall be refused and every legal one recorded
A step shall not become Verified without a linked evidence record: test output, read-back or change summary
Existing goals, plans and transactions shall write ledger records from request to read-back
Builder and verifier runs shall write their stories, commits and test results to the ledger
Percent complete shall be computed in code as the weighted sum of earned credit of 10, 40, 80 and 100, and an unverified step shall never exceed 40%
The board shall show Now, Handled, Needs your yes and Coming up, each read from a core projection of the ledger. No window component shall compute a state
For any step, the evidence panel shall show what changed, what was checked and what was read back, in plain language
Skipped, failed and unverified work shall appear in a Not done panel with its reason within one tick

Every accepted work order and every case shall get its own dashboard with no manual step: percent complete over time, each step's state, evidence coverage, time in each stage, and where the work is now and next
A shift handover report shall be generated from the ledger each morning, listing done, waiting, blocked and next, every line traceable to a record
A flow view shall draw the work as a diagram from the ledger, move an item when its step changes state, and show what blocks what
The scorecard shall chart each measure over time against its target, and each figure shall equal its documented ledger query run by hand
A person reading the board cold shall be able to say what is happening now and what is next within 30 seconds
The sensing heartbeat shall tell delayed from absent, and every stall over 1 second shall be attributed to a named stage
Each subsystem shall report a health state, and the board shall answer "why is KUE not doing anything?"
Pause shall stop all watching and preparing while keeping the data, and a paused KUE shall say it is paused
A corrupted store shall be detected at launch, and the documented restore shall succeed
Approval shall be by a Touch ID or password session, with the camera as optional corroboration. Conflicting identity shall fail closed
Helpers shall load only from the signed bundle, and the enrollment file shall be unreadable without the Keychain
The model router shall try rules, then retrieval, then the on-device model, then a larger local model. Arithmetic and status questions shall never call a model
Every agent shall stop within one tick of the kill switch
KUE shall read only sources the person allowed, and shall list those sources on request
A document placed in the watched folder shall be recognised on the device within one minute, create a ledger record, and cause no network request
Extraction shall propose who, what, amount and due date, each with a confidence and its exact place in the source
Every extracted date and amount shall pass rule checks in code before it is shown as fact, and each check shall report passed, failed, not run or inconclusive
A field looked for and not found shall be recorded as not found. A field never looked for shall be absent from the record
A low-confidence or failed field shall be asked of the person with the page shown. KUE shall never fill it by guessing
A date that can be read two ways, such as 03/04/2027, shall be asked, not assumed
The same bill arriving twice, on paper and by mail, shall become one item that keeps both sources
Two items from one sender about a month or a year apart shall produce a proposed recurring item, and future promises shall be created only after the person agrees
With calendar permission granted, events shall stay on the Mac and deadlines may refer to them. With it denied, KUE shall say so and work without it
Mail shall be read read-only by the option chosen in the Sprint 7 test, a bill arriving by mail shall become a promise, and KUE shall hold no ability to send mail
Text inside a document or a mail shall be treated as data. It shall never change KUE's instructions, policy or actions
A promise shall have a due date, a source and an owner. Without a due date, KUE shall ask for one before accepting it
A promise shall be in exactly one state: open, overdue, kept, dropped or missed
A promise past its due time shall become overdue. After 48 more hours with no answer it shall become missed, leave the open list and stay on the record
A kept promise shall record the date it was done and how that is known: by proof KUE read, or by the person's word
A promise done after its due date shall be shown as kept late and shall not count toward Kept Rate
A dropped promise shall keep the reason it was dropped
A responsibility shall be a standing rule with the sources it watches and the deadlines and cases under it. Adopting one shall list what KUE will watch
A responsibility's state shall be computed in code as In control, Needs you or At risk from its items

Days of margin shall be shown for each responsibility as the days to its nearest lapse date. A responsibility whose margin is shorter than the preparation time shall be marked At risk before the date arrives
KUE shall offer the responsibility templates you approved, and shall accept one written in the person's own words
A morning board shall be produced every day at a set time with Handled, Needs your yes and Coming up, and items needing the person shall come first
Every line on the morning board shall trace to a ledger record
At most three questions shall be asked of the person at once
A reminder shall be delivered on the Mac only inside the interruption policy of importance, urgency, quiet hours and daily budget, and only the person shall be able to edit that policy
The person shall be able to answer kept, not yet or dropped from the notification itself
After three "not yet" answers on one item, the question shall change to: drop it, or make it smaller?
An item whose words show distress shall no longer be chased
A coming-up view shall show the next 30, 60 and 90 days of deadlines, with the money due charted by week
Kept Rate shall be computed in code from the promises due in the period, and shall equal a hand count
The baseline question shall be asked once, before the first board, and never again. A skipped baseline shall be recorded as skipped
A monthly score shall show deadlines kept, kept late, missed and handled with a trend, and each number shall equal a hand count from the ledger
Every action shall carry a risk score from severity, occurrence and detection, mapped to approval levels 0 to 4 with defaults you approved. An unknown action shall score highest
Every prepared item shall offer Yes, Not yet and No, and a No shall require a reason
A Yes shall be signed and bound to the item's exact content, and any later change to that content shall void it
For any item, explain-back shall show the exact source line and the checks run, in plain words. A sentence with no source shall be removed
A case shall have a checklist of required documents, and every checklist item shall always exist, whatever the case type requires
Arriving documents shall be matched to checklist items, percent complete shall update, and missing items shall be named
Two documents in a case that disagree on a name, number, amount or date shall be reported with the page of each value
A draft shall never count toward a case's percent complete
A case shall close only with the person's signature. KUE shall report what it checked and found, and shall never state that a case is complete or compliant
A case at 100% shall export as one file holding every document in checklist order with an index, and the export shall be recorded
Onboarding shall explain each permission in plain words before asking for it, and KUE shall work with any permission denied
A new person starting unaided shall see a board with their own first item within 10 minutes
Before any source is watched, onboarding shall show the tester agreement and record its acceptance

requirements.text: "This is wrong" shall correct the item, keep the reason, and create a work order
The person shall be able to see everything KUE keeps about them
Forgetting one item or one source shall remove what was learned from it, and the raw database shall show it gone
Wipe everything shall remove all KUE data from the Mac
Forgetting shall leave a marker that a deletion happened, with none of the deleted content, and the integrity check shall still pass
The person shall be able to export everything KUE keeps, as the original files and as plain JSON lines

requirements.text: On leaving, KUE shall ask one optional question about the reason, once

requirements.text: After seven days without the board being opened, KUE shall ask one short question once, and shall not ask again for that lapse

requirements.text: On request, KUE shall produce a counts-only report of days opened, items, answers and scores, with no document content. The person shall read it and send it by hand, and nothing shall be sent automatically

requirements.text: With the window closed, a queue and scheduler shall keep watching. A document arriving at night shall be read and appear on the next morning board
A standing approval shall have a scope, a limit and an expiry, and shall never cover approval levels 3 or 4
Unattended, only work under a standing approval shall run. A step above it shall stop and appear in Needs your yes
On a failed invariant, repeated failure, heat or an unknown state, the queue shall pause within one tick and say why
After a crash in the middle of a step, the step shall be marked unknown and then verified. It shall never be assumed successful
Over seven nights at least 95% of scheduled runs shall start, with no unverified success and every stop explained
KUE shall slow itself under heat, and its CPU, memory, heat and power use while always on shall be recorded

Every action shall be declared in a tool registry with its level, privacy class, risk, verifier and rollback. An undeclared action shall be refused, and an unavailable tool shall be reported as unavailable
A draft reply shall cite the document it answers, shall be marked as a draft everywhere it appears, and shall never be sent by KUE
The form helper shall fill a copy of a form, show the source of every filled field, and leave unknown fields empty and listed
Payment preparation shall show payee, amount, due date and source together, and KUE shall start no payment
Given 50 documents and mails carrying hidden instructions, KUE shall take no action and change no policy
KUE shall install on a clean Mac without a security warning, and shall keep its permissions after an update
An update shall preserve the ledger and the permissions. In Release 1 the person installs updates from a signed file, and KUE shall not fetch them itself
A wrong item found after a yes shall open a corrective action, which shall close only with a linked regression test
In-app help and a user guide shall let a new person complete their first three tasks without asking anyone
A backup restored on a second user account shall run with the ledger intact
No personal data shall leave the person's Mac in Release 1. Target: Zero, observed on the network at every phase gate
KUE shall open no network connection except one the person set up themselves. Target: The only candidate is a mailbox connection, if that option is chosen in Sprint 7
An agent shall receive only fields the privacy firewall has cleared. Target: Every model input
Data at rest shall be protected. Enrollment is wrapped by the Keychain, and the store's protection is a named control or a risk you accepted. Target: Stated in the threat model
Every entry point shall have a control or an accepted risk signed by you. Target: All entry points
No critical or high finding shall be open at release. Target: Zero
Scheduled runs shall start. Target: At least 95% over seven nights
Access shall stay steady while the owner is seated. Target: Fewer than 10 changes an hour; zero false accepts for a second person
The live test suite shall hold no stale or ignored test. Target: Each passes, or is deleted with a reason
Time to first text on the ten most common requests. Target: Median of 5 seconds or less
Time to read a document after it arrives. Target: 1 minute or less
Memory, CPU, cold start and battery. Target: Budgets are set in Sprint 15 and met on your Mac. No numbers exist yet
Amount and due date both right. Target: At least 90% of documents
Steps with read-back evidence. Target: 100%
Wrong items found after a yes. Target: Fewer than 5 per 100 signed
First board for a new person, unaided. Target: 10 minutes or less
Now and next understood on a cold read. Target: 30 seconds or less
No code or internal term on any screen a user sees. Target: Checked against the design system
macOS on Apple silicon, English, US dollars, US date formats. Target: Your MacBook Air is the reference machine
Every functional requirement shall have a test or evidence named for it. Target: All, at release
A backup shall restore with the ledger intact. Target: Drilled before release, then monthly
Local models shall be benchmarked again on the labelled document set. Target: Every quarter
The date is real. Applies to: every due date. A date that does not exist fails. A due date already past is shown as overdue, never hidden
The date reads one way. Applies to: every date. Two readings are possible: inconclusive, and the person is asked
The amount is money. Applies to: every amount. It must parse with a currency and match the line it was read from, or the person is asked
The total matches its lines. Applies to: bills with line items. The sum differs from the total: both are shown
The amount is in the usual range. Applies to: a sender with three or more earlier bills. Outside the range: flagged for a look, never blocked
The payee is known. Applies to: every payee. A new payee, or changed payee details: flagged
Not a duplicate. Applies to: every new item. Same sender, amount and period already on file: merged, both sources kept
Recurrence. Applies to: items from one sender. About a month or a year apart: a recurring item is proposed
Documents agree. Applies to: every case. A name, number, amount or date differs: reported with the page of each value
The checklist is covered. Applies to: every case. A required item has no document: named as missing. A draft does not count
Expiry ahead. Applies to: ids, policies, registrations. An expiry inside the watch window becomes a promise
A source is present. Applies to: every sentence shown. No source: the sentence is removed
The signature still binds. Applies to: every signed answer. The content differs from what was signed: the signature is void
The ledger chain holds. Applies to: the ledger. A record was altered: integrity failure, and the line stops
